content.text:
I fixed all three queue problems in `src/queue.js`, and `npm test` passes with 5 tests. I didn't run the new tests against the old code, so I haven't confirmed they fail without the fix.

- **Hang after a failure:** a failed job never freed its slot or started the next job. A job that threw synchronously also left the queue in a bad state. Every job now frees its slot and starts the next one whether it succeeds or fails. A failure still rejects only that job's own promise.
- **`onIdle()` resolving too early:** it only checked that nothing was pending, so it resolved while jobs were still running. It now also waits for the running count to reach zero.
- **One job at a time after `pause()`/`resume()`:** `next()` started a single job per call. It now keeps starting jobs until all free slots are filled, so `resume()` fills every free slot.

I added three regression tests in `test/queue.test.js`. They cover failing jobs (async and synchronous), `onIdle()` with jobs still running, and `resume()` with concurrency 4 starting 4 jobs and never exceeding 4.

I fixed all three queue problems in `src/queue.js`, and `npm test` passes with 5 tests. I didn't run the new tests against the old code, so I haven't confirmed they fail without the fix.

- **Hang after a failure:** a failed job never freed its slot or started the next job. A job that threw synchronously also left the queue in a bad state. Every job now frees its slot and starts the next one whether it succeeds or fails. A failure still rejects only that job's own promise.
- **`onIdle()` resolving too early:** it only checked that nothing was pending, so it resolved while jobs were still running. It now also waits for the running count to reach zero.
- **One job at a time after `pause()`/`resume()`:** `next()` started a single job per call. It now keeps starting jobs until all free slots are filled, so `resume()` fills every free slot.

I added three regression tests in `test/queue.test.js`. They cover failing jobs (async and synchronous), `onIdle()` with jobs still running, and `resume()` with concurrency 4 starting 4 jobs and never exceeding 4.
